summary: Read and search your saved Readeck articles.
release_notes: Initial token-based reader with library search, reading positions, images and article actions.

steps.text: Use an HTTPS Readeck instance and create an API token that permits reading and updating bookmarks.
Close Cobalt normally. Install the token from a private file using the computer CLI.
steps.command: kobo secret set readeck --app readeck --server https://<server> --from <token-file> --device <address>

steps.text: Open Readeck, enter the same HTTPS server address, and choose Use saved token. Alternatively, tap Next to enter the token on the Kobo.
